

## 6  NetCoMi paired analysis

```{r netcomi-construct}
net_pair <- NetCoMi::netConstruct(
  ass_hb, ass_lb,
  dataType    = "partialCorr",
  sparsMethod = "none",
  verbose     = 0
)
```

```{r netcomi-analyse}
net_props <- NetCoMi::netAnalyze(
  net_pair,
  centrLCC    = FALSE,
  clustMethod = "cluster_fast_greedy",
  hubPar      = "betweenness",
  hubQuant    = 0.95,
  normDeg = TRUE, normBetw = TRUE, normClose = TRUE, normEigen = TRUE
)

summary(net_props,
        groupNames = c("High Bioactive", "Low Bioactive"),
        showCentr  = c("degree", "between"),
        numbNodes  = 6)
```

---
  
  ## 7  Compare HB vs LB topology
  
  ```{r netcomi-compare}
net_comp <- NetCoMi::netCompare(
  net_props,
  permTest = FALSE,
  verbose  = FALSE,
  seed     = 42
)

summary(net_comp,
        groupNames = c("High Bioactive", "Low Bioactive"),
        showCentr  = c("degree", "between"),
        numbNodes  = 5)
```

diff_net <- NetCoMi::diffnet(
  net_pair,
